name: sentinel2_reflectance2022
title: Sentinel-2 before 2022
abstract:
This layer is designed for Sentinel-2 images before the year 2022.

The Sentinel-2 mission consists of two polar orbiting Sentinel-2A and Sentinel-2B equipped with the MSI (Multi-Spectral Instrument) sensor. It has 13 bands from 10 – 60 m pixel size. More info here: Sentinel 2 Bands and Combinations - GIS Geography

Here is a list of the layers which can be selected.

- Simple RGB. B04, B03, B02.

- False Color. NIR, Green, Blue (B08, B04, B02).

- False Color Urban SWIR22, SWIR16, Red - (B12, B11, B04).

- SWIR - Short Wave Infrared RGB Composite. SWIR22, Narrow NIR, Blue - (B12, B8A, B04).

- NDVI. Normalized difference vegetation index. (B8-B4) / (B8+B4).

- NDWI . Normalized difference wetness index. NIR, Red - (B03 - B08) / (B03 + B08).

- NBI. Normalized difference burn index. NIR, SWIR22 - (B08 - B12) / (B08 + B12).

- MSI. Moisture index. SWIR16, Water vapour - (B11 / B09).
